data.title: CLI errors outside handlers go through failure() with JSON
data.description: B5. Unknown command exits 0 with empty output (reproduced 2026-09-18); unknown flags print no JSON; --json --json prints text and still creates the task; repeated --title writes {title:[a,b]} permanently and reports success; repeated --task / --fields crash. Route cac errors and unknown commands through failure(); reject array values before any event is written. Same class as the --rejected bug. Evidence: docs/research/contract-stress-audit-2026-09.md §4-5
